record_title: The factor four is sharp for two-stage adaptive randomized pivoting
provenance: Scientific analysis of worst-case approximation factors for two-stage adaptive randomized pivoting and conditional projection-DPP column selection.
limitations: The sharpness family approaches rank deficiency and large condition number. The theorem treats two stages of sizes 1+1 and does not establish sharpness of the general product bound for more stages or larger blocks. It assumes exact dominant right singular vectors and exact arithmetic and does not address approximate subspaces, finite precision, fixed-precision stopping, or Nystrom-specific structure. Originality is to the best of our knowledge.
